body-classes: public
---

```{=html}
<header class="pub-head">
  <a class="pub-brand" href="index.html">Coding Provenance Workshop</a>
  <nav class="pub-nav" aria-label="Site">
    <a href="index.html">About the workshop</a>
  </nav>
</header>

<section class="gate" aria-labelledby="gate-title">
  <div class="gate-panel">
    <h1 class="gate-title" id="gate-title">Participant area</h1>
    <p class="gate-lede">Session links, readings and materials for the second edition, 1–4 December 2026. Enter the participant password to continue.</p>

    <form class="gate-form" novalidate>
      <label class="pub-label" for="gate-password">Password</label>
      <div class="gate-field">
        <input id="gate-password" name="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required aria-describedby="gate-message">
        <button type="submit">Enter</button>
      </div>
      <p class="gate-message" id="gate-message" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <label class="gate-remember"><input type="checkbox" name="remember" checked> Keep me signed in on this device</label>
      <noscript><p class="gate-message">The participant area needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
    </form>

    <div class="rule-hatched" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <p class="gate-help">No password? Ask the <a href="index.html#organisers">workshop organisers</a>.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<script src="assets/public.js"></script>
```
